<style>
  .skills-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #64a19d, #7464a1);
    color: white;
    padding: 4rem 0;
    text-align: center;
  }
  
  .skills-section {
    padding: 4rem 0;
  }
  
  .skill-category {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-left: 4px solid #64a19d;
  }
  
  .category-title {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: #333;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }
  
  .category-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: #64a19d;
    margin-right: 1rem;
  }
  
  .skills-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  
  .skill-item {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid #e9ecef;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .skill-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  }
  
  .skill-name {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: #333;
  }
  
  .skill-level {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .skill-level-text {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #64a19d;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .skill-bar {
    flex: 1;
    height: 6px;
    background: #e9ecef;
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  
  .skill-progress {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #64a19d, #7464a1);
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .skill-description {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  
  .certifications-section {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    padding: 4rem 0;
  }
  
  .certification-card {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-left: 3px solid #64a19d;
  }
  
  .certification-title {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: #333;
  }
  
  .certification-issuer {
    color: #64a19d;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .certification-date {
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  
  .tools-section {
    padding: 4rem 0;
  }
  
  .tool-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  
  .tool-item {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1rem;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .tool-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
  
  .tool-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: #64a19d;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .tool-name {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #333;
  }
</style>
